create_atomicdata_from_ase: create an AtomicData object from an ASE Atoms object with optional graph construction using a cutoff radius
convert_atomicdata_to_ase: convert a single-graph AtomicData object back to an ASE Atoms object with forces and energy
batch_atomicdata_list: batch a list of single-graph AtomicData objects into one contiguous batched AtomicData object
create_atomicdata_from_dict: create an AtomicData object from a Python dictionary containing required tensor keys like pos and atomic_numbers
clone_atomicdata: clone an AtomicData object by performing a deep copy of all tensor and non-tensor attributes
